title: 第五十二章 新任务第五十一章 这也行
slug: 魔头别夺舍了我们正道快没人了
lines: 此时，位列最末的巨鹿妖尊咬了咬牙，最终还是硬着头皮，向前迈出一步。
“妖帝陛下，尚有一事......需向您禀报。”
王座上的妖帝见是巨鹿妖尊出列，神色间掠过一丝明显的不悦，但仍抬了抬手，示意道:
“此前，属下推测，那逃遁的小妖很可能潜入了东洲地界。毕竟那里并非我妖族势力范围，人手稀少，便于隐匿。因此，属下曾派遣了一些得力手下，潜入东洲境内，暗中查访那小妖的下落。”
“然而，在一处人族城池中，属下派遣的手下不慎暴露了行迹，引来了仙灵剑宗的人族修士，导致手下尽数被歼。”
妖帝的目光陡然一凝。
“你亲自出手了?“他声音低沉，带着审视。巨鹿妖尊此刻气息虚浮不定，伤势未愈，显然经历过一场恶战，妖帝自然能猜到他也参与了。
“你好大的胆子!“
随着一声怒喝，磅礴如山的恐怖威压轰然落下，犹如实质，将原本站立的巨鹿妖尊硬生生压得双膝跪地，骨节发出不堪重负的**。
那威压几乎凝成黑雾，弥漫在空气中，散发着令人心悸的寒意。
“妖帝陛下息怒!请听属下解释!”
巨鹿妖尊急忙告饶。他本已重伤在身，此刻在这等威压之下，只觉筋骨欲裂，若再持续片刻，怕是真要留下难以痊愈的道伤，甚至沦为废妖。
“说。今日你若给不出一个让本帝信服的理由，这妖尊之位，你也就不必再坐了。”
妖帝冷哼一声，挥袖间撤去了威压。但任谁都看得出，若巨鹿妖尊的解释无法令他满意，后果绝不仅仅是剥夺尊位那么简单。
“属下......属下是通过‘血禁窥踪秘法'观测到，那处人族城池附近，确有那小妖短暂停留过的微弱痕迹!而且，当时仙灵剑宗那位声名鹊起的‘小剑仙’恰巧也在场，附近亦无化神期真人守护。属下想着，若能趁机擒杀那小剑仙，或许能逼问出小妖的下落，这才......”
巨鹿妖尊这番话，只有“看到小剑仙在场”是实情。
他绝不可能吐露真实缘由-难道要他说，自己是为了修炼那有伤天和的邪功，需要大量人族修士精血，才私自派遣妖族潜入东洲，妄图篡夺一城，结果撞上了仙灵剑宗?
难道要他说，自己是在秘法中窥见那小剑仙孤身出现，便心生贪念，欲以其精血助长自身修为，这才不顾大局，悍然率领妖族进犯东洲?
就为了他的一己私欲，同时招惹东洲仙朝与仙灵剑宗这两大庞然巨物?
若真如此禀报，巨鹿妖尊估计，自己非但保不住妖尊之位，恐怕顷刻间就会魂飞魄散，尸骨无存。
因此，他只能编织谎言，将祸水引向妖帝最为忌惮的“小妖”身上，并巧妙地牵扯出妖族与仙灵剑宗之间宿怨的旧账。唯有如此，他的行动才显得“师出有名”，至少表面上能自圆其说。
若换作其他心思缜密、多疑善虑之人，或许会对这番说辞心存三分怀疑，即便当面不发作，事后也定会暗中调查。
偏偏这位妖帝，性格刚愎自用，极度自负。
他觉得这理由合乎逻辑，并且深信在自己的绝对威势之下，巨鹿妖尊绝无胆量做出过于出格、损害妖族整体利益的事情。
如此一来，他反而信了七八分。
“然后呢?你总不会告诉本帝，你被一个人族的小辈打得如此狼狈吧?还有，那只小妖，最终可曾寻到?”
巨鹿妖尊连忙摆出一副痛心疾首、力不从心的模样。
“仙灵剑宗那边反应极快!发现我妖族踪迹后，竟在极短时间内便调遣了两位化神期真人前来驰援!纵使属下接到消息后第一时间赶赴现场，但毕竟路途遥远......终究是仙灵剑宗离得更近。属下以一敌二，寡不敌众，这才......”
content_en:
At this time, the Giant Deer Demon Lord, who was ranked last, gritted his teeth, and finally bit the bullet and took a step forward.
"Your Majesty the Demon Emperor, there is something else I need to report to you."
The Demon Emperor on the throne saw a trace of obvious displeasure flashing across his face when he saw the Giant Deer Demon Lord coming out, but he still raised his hand and signaled:
"Speak."
"Previously, my subordinates speculated that the escaped little demon might have sneaked into the territory of Dongzhou. After all, it is not within the scope of our demon clan's influence, and the manpower is sparse, making it easier to hide. Therefore, my subordinates have sent some capable men to sneak into Dongzhou and secretly investigate the whereabouts of the little demon."
"However, in a human city, the men sent by my subordinates accidentally exposed their whereabouts and attracted the human monks from the Immortal Sword Sect, resulting in all of their men being wiped out."
The Demon Emperor's eyes suddenly condensed.
"Did you take action yourself?" His voice was low and scrutinizing. The Julu Demon Lord's breath was unstable at the moment, and his injuries were not healed. He had obviously experienced a fierce battle, and the Demon Emperor could naturally guess that he was also involved.
"Yes...yes."
"You are so brave!"
With an angry roar, the majestic mountain-like terrifying pressure suddenly fell, like a substance, forcing the standing Giant Deer Demon Lord to kneel on his knees, and his joints screamed under the load.
The pressure almost condensed into black mist, filling the air with a heart-stopping chill.
"Your Majesty the Demon Emperor, please calm down! Please listen to your explanation!"
The Julu Demon Lord hurriedly begged for mercy. He was already seriously injured, but now under such pressure, his muscles and bones were about to burst. If it continued for a while, he might really be left with wounds that were difficult to heal, or even become a useless demon.
"Tell me. If you can't give me a reason to convince me today, you won't have to sit on this Demon Lord's position anymore."
The Demon Emperor snorted coldly and waved his sleeves to remove the pressure. But everyone can see that if Julu Demon Lord’s explanation cannot satisfy him, the consequences will not be as simple as depriving him of his position.
"My subordinate... I observed through the 'Blood Forbidden Sneaking Secret Technique' that there were indeed faint traces of the little demon's brief stay near the human city! Moreover, the famous 'Little Sword Immortal' of the Fairy Spirit Sword Sect happened to be present at that time, and there was no real person in the God Transformation stage nearby to protect him. I thought that if I could take the opportunity to capture and kill the little sword immortal, I might be able to find out the whereabouts of the little demon, so..."
The words of Julu Demon Lord are only true when he saw the presence of the Little Sword Immortal.
There is absolutely no way he could tell the real reason - could he say that he secretly sent demon clansmen to sneak into the East Continent in order to practice the evil skills that harmed the world and required a large amount of blood from human monks, in an attempt to usurp a city, but ended up running into the Immortal Spirit Sword Sect?
Do you want him to say that he saw the little sword fairy appearing alone in the secret method, and then he became greedy and wanted to use his blood essence to boost his own cultivation, so he disregarded the overall situation and brazenly led the demon tribe to invade Dongzhou?
Just for his own selfish desires, he provoked the two behemoths Dongzhou Immortal Dynasty and Xianling Sword Sect at the same time?
If such a report is really made, the Julu Demon Lord estimates that not only will he not be able to keep his position as the Demon Lord, he will probably lose his soul and body in an instant.
Therefore, he could only weave lies to lead the trouble to the "little demon" that the demon emperor was most afraid of, and cleverly involved the old grudge between the demon clan and the Fairy Sword Sect. Only in this way can his actions appear to be "famous", at least on the surface, they can be justified.
If it were someone else who is thoughtful, suspicious and thoughtful, they might be suspicious of these remarks. Even if they don't show up in person, they will definitely investigate secretly afterwards.
However, this demon emperor has a headstrong personality and is extremely conceited.
He felt that this reason was logical, and he was convinced that under his absolute power, Julu Demon Lord would never have the guts to do anything that would go too far and harm the overall interests of the demon clan.
In this way, he believed it 70-80%.
"Then what? You will never tell me that you were beaten so badly by a junior from the human race, right? Also, was that little demon found in the end?"
The Julu Demon Lord quickly put on a look of grief and powerlessness.
"The Fairy Spirit Sword Sect reacted very quickly! After discovering the traces of our demon tribe, they actually dispatched two real people in the God Transformation stage to come to the rescue in a very short period of time! Even though my subordinates rushed to the scene as soon as they received the news, the road is long after all... After all, the Fairy Spirit Sword Sect is closer. With one against two, my subordinates are outnumbered, so..."
